english: Fame-from-the-Gods, tell me a story about the aurochs. A herdsman went into the forest. There he caught sight of a huge aurochs. The aurochs struck him with its horns. Did he die? He did not die: he climbed into a tree and slept there. At dawn he came home unharmed. That is a good story!
